title: brain test fails when nothing ran
why: A wrong path or a file with no `test()` used to report green. With native sockets it runs against the app's own `brain run`, and doctor no longer claims a clean run when tests did not run.
changelog: fails on a path that does not exist
no longer says no errors were captured
steps: Pass `brain test` one existing test file, or no path; a file that declares no `test()` now fails.
